title: Health Resort east wing room 306 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the room 306 of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing room 306 key (E306 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing room 306.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 308 through the balcony.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In the Tarcone Director's Office on the desk in the breachable room

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - On the nightstand of the 2nd cabin with the safe

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- On the desk with the computer on the second floor of the office building at the pier.

- On the desk in the small office next to the entrance of the administration building at the health resort.

- In a key rack in west wing room 202 at the health resort.

- On the floor below the key rack in the utility room next to west wing room 227 at the health resort.

- In the key rack near the central stairs on the second floor of the east wing at the health resort.

- On the floor below the key rack near the central stairs on the third floor of the east wing at the health resort.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 306 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

- Room 308:
